prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picosoc-uart-div
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 775387e54faba718
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback divider 64 sent 0xa5 but recv_buf_data returned 0xe0 (TRAP: uart data mismatch got 0xe0 want 0xa5, FAIL 0xdead). Both data/stop states test recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4) so bits are sampled after ~4 cycles instead of a full cfg_divider period, causing bit-slip from 0xa5 to 0xe0. Fix restores full-bit wait to cfg_divider in both states. Refs picosoc/simpleuart.v:20, picosoc/picosoc.v:190.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 775387e54faba718 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
